description: Compute daily active users (DAU) for the gaming analytics platform. A player is active on a UTC calendar day if they have at least one event that day whose event_type is not 'heartbeat'. Exclude players flagged as test accounts. Output columns: activity_date (DATE), dau (INT64). Sort by activity_date.

is_test_account.description: TRUE for internal QA accounts; may be NULL for legacy players (treat as FALSE)

edge_cases: Player with several events in one day counts once
Session spanning midnight makes the player active on both days
Player with only heartbeat events is not active
is_test_account NULL must be treated as FALSE, not excluded
common_failure_modes: FM3: COUNT(player_id) instead of COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) counts events rather than players
FM5: WHERE is_test_account = FALSE silently drops players whose flag is NULL
